programme.desc: The story revolves around a maverick, a band of female warriors and a group of ruthless bandits who teams up to raid the emperor's tomb. Will they be successful?

programme.title: The Condemned
programme.desc: A righteous man who can't fight and an unjustly wronged swordsman team up to battle against evil.

programme.title: Young Lovers
programme.desc: A chauffeur's daughter and the heir to a cruise ship conglomerate fall in love as they try to outwit greedy relatives who have sights on the company.

programme.title: Legend of the Bat
programme.desc: Director Chor Yuen reunites with novelist, Gu Long, and superstar, Ti Lung, in this exciting sequel to Clans of Intrigue.

programme.title: Rear Entrance
programme.desc: This moving tale centers on a childless woman who cares for an emotionally battered girl.

programme.title: Four Riders
programme.desc: Set in Seoul right after the Korean War, a kung-fu master, combat instructor, explosives expert and missiles specialist take on a drug smuggling ring.

programme.title: Sons of Good Earth
programme.desc: This multiple award-winning film is King Hu's first solo production, a tale of the Sino-Japanese War that ends in artistic and emotional triumph.

programme.title: The Golden Lion
programme.desc: Chiao Hsiung plays a bandit who steals from the rich and gives to the poor, all the while risking the threat of his evil nemesis, the evil bounty hunter Wang.

programme.title: The Monkey Goes West
programme.desc: This is the first of four related Shaw Brothers film adaptations of the legendary Journey To The West.

programme.title: Puppy Love
programme.desc: Playfulness abounds and innocence is lost in this tale of two naughty females who grow up and discover boys together.

programme.title: The Secret of the Dirk
programme.desc: Lovely Ching Li and handsome Chang I unite as star-and-sword-crossed comrades who take on the vicious Black Tigers gang in a quest for hidden wealth.

programme.title: Duel of Fist
programme.desc: In this thriller by Chang Cheh, David Chiang and Ti Lung play two skilled boxers, one of whom finds his half brother in the Thai underworld.

programme.title: Family Light Affair
programme.desc: Serio-comic clashes of cultures ensue when a Mainland Chinese family try to make a go of it in Hong Kong.

programme.title: Descendant of the Sun
programme.desc: A magic solar baby who's sent to Earth by a benevolent god grows up to have superpowers but loses them during solar eclipses.

programme.title: The Perfumed Arrow
programme.desc: A young woman, who has gone through life disguised as a boy, must deal with her family's pressure for her to marry and the love of another woman.

programme.title: Disciples of Shaolin
programme.desc: One of Chang Cheh's finest films, this saga stars Alexander Fu Sheng in his greatest martial arts role as a penniless country boy who fights his way to riches.

programme.title: Passing Flickers
programme.desc: This comedy contains dramatisations of some of the funniest and most surreal film gossips of director Li Han-Hsiang's 30 year career.

programme.title: Return to the 36th Chamber
programme.desc: In this comedic sequel to the 36th Chamber of Shaolin, Gordon Liu is hired to impersonate the 36th Chamber's founder!

programme.title: The Singing Escort
programme.desc: Betty Ting Pei plays a girl hiding from her father while working as a club singer in Japan. Then her father sends someone for her only for the man to fall in love with her.

programme.title: The New One-Armed Swordsman
programme.desc: A swordsman (David Chiang) is moved to fight back after the love of his life is kidnapped and his best friend murdered by a gang.

programme.title: The Tiger and the Widow
programme.desc: A woman gets involved in a Ching Dynasty salt smuggling ring that stinks of missing persons and dilemmas gone rotten.

programme.title: Killer Clans
programme.desc: This abourer and complex adaptation of a popular wuxia novel contains conspiracies, stratagems, and sword fights aplenty.

programme.title: The Lady Hermit
programme.desc: A pair of female martial artists end up banding together to go up against the evil Black Demon. Starring Cheng Pei Pei.

programme.title: Let's Fall in Love
programme.desc: Pressured by his parents to marry prior to taking over his father's business, Guan rejects every girl they find but then, he stumbles upon the perfect one?

programme.title: Diary of a Lady-killer
programme.desc: A man is arrested after every woman he had sexual trysts with ends up dead shortly afterwards but the murders continue.

programme.title: The Proud Twins
programme.desc: This tale of hidden treasure features the legendary Alexander Fu Sheng as a young wushu warrior, in a film considered director Chu Yuan's best ever.

programme.title: My Name Ain't Suzie
programme.desc: A poor young woman becomes a popular bargirl in Hong Kong's gritty response to Hollywood's The World of Suzie Wong.

programme.title: Return of Reincarnated Swordsman
programme.desc: Tu Ku, having mastered the Silkworm skills, heads for Wu Tang to challenge Yun but finds him gone. However, the leader of the Ega Clan issues a challenge.

programme.title: Rose, Be My Love
programme.desc: A love rectangle lies at the heart of this romantic drama with an eve of World War II setting. Starring Kwan Shan, Li Ting.

programme.title: Have Sword Will Travel
programme.desc: A drifter (David Chiang) and another swordsman (Ti Lung) are competitors for a woman's love who fate turns into brothers in arms.

programme.title: Mr Funny Bone
programme.desc: Whenever Mr. Funny Bone travels about with his sidekick Big Potato, he often gets involved in all manner of charming comic mishaps.

programme.title: The Gambling Syndicate
programme.desc: When a young provincial detective seeks to take down a local gambling syndicate with the help of two convicts, will they succeed?

programme.title: Crocodile River
programme.desc: Two students fall in love but their two families are enemies and separated by a river that is filled with crocodiles and beasts.

programme.title: The Weird Man
programme.desc: Cheng Tien Chi plays a righteous priest with supernatural powers, who returns from the dead to wreak havoc against one of the corrupt kingdoms.

programme.title: When the Clouds Roll by
programme.desc: A doctor falls for a schizophrenic old classmate he's treating who refuses to accept that her lover is dead.

programme.title: The Casino
programme.desc: After they reunite in a casino, two lovers (Lily Ho and Yueh Hua) vow to rid the place of corrupt military leaders and criminal others.

programme.title: Whose Baby Is in the Classroom?
programme.desc: Inoue Umetsugu's last Shaw film before his untimely death is a testament to the auteur's carefree comic talent.

programme.title: Woman of the Night

programme.title: The Daredevils
